caption: The drawing depicts a single metal object resembling a perforated spatula or flat spoon with a handle. The main part of the object is brownish with patches of rust or discoloration, and it has a flat, rounded blade with numerous small circular holes and several straight, elongated slots arranged in a symmetrical pattern. The handle is cylindrical, tapers slightly, and is colored in similar brown and gray rusty tones. The object is positioned diagonally from the lower left to the upper right against a plain, off-white background. There is some small handwritten text in brown ink near the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Spatula
